PRINTABLE OPPOSITE CARDS

Opposite Flashcards: print all twelve cards

Twelve opposite cards, two to a printed page — six pairs from big and small to open and closed.

Made for age 3 and up — one clear picture per card, pairs kept together in order. The cards print in card order — cut them out or use them as they are. When you are ready, choose Print Cards.

Back to class ↗

Printing happens in your browser — nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed. No PDF is involved.
